requests.title: Approve Technology Stack for Zynoa
requests.summary: Stack in docs/plan/BUILD-PLAN.md section 1: Next.js + React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui (site, dashboard), Tauri 2 (desktop), React Native + Expo (mobile), Fastify + Zod API, Temporal (TS) + Python media worker, Postgres 16 + pgvector (Drizzle), Redis/Valkey, Better Auth, Vercel AI SDK behind ModelGateway, Cloudflare R2 + WAF + Turnstile, Vercel/Cloudflare front-end hosting, containers for API/workers, Vitest/Playwright/k6, pnpm + Turborepo.
proposed_changes: Adopt the stack in docs/plan/BUILD-PLAN.md section 1 for all Zynoa apps
